scope: mathematical novelty audit after the finite one-flip lazy-repair counterexample

sources.title: Fully Dynamic Matching in Bipartite Graphs
verified_observations: For beta_minus=beta-1, treats full and deficient edges and restores validity through alternating paths.
Bounds an alternating path and reports at most O(beta) H-edge updates per external update.
Uses orientation and, in the general case, bucketed approximate degree information.
sources.boundary: The frozen one-flip FIFO variant has none of these alternating-path, orientation, or bucket mechanisms; its failure is not a refutation of this algorithm or theorem.

sources.title: New Trade-Offs for Fully Dynamic Matching via Hierarchical EDCS
verified_observations: Introduces hierarchical EDCS as a generalization for dynamic matching trade-offs.
sources.boundary: No claim in this audit targets HEDCS or its maintenance analysis.

sources.title: Deterministic Dynamic Maximal Matching in Sublinear Update Time
verified_observations: Uses EDCS in a different role for matching high-degree vertices in a sublinear-update maximal-matching algorithm.
sources.boundary: This does not validate or analyze the one-flip local rule.

sources.title: A Faster Deterministic Algorithm for Fully Dynamic Maximal Matching
verified_observations: Describes EDCS as a verification-and-repair mechanism in recent dynamic maximal matching work and introduces a separate subgraph-system framework.
sources.boundary: The existence of cascading verification/repair mechanisms reinforces that a one-toggle local rule is a distinct object; no novelty claim is made.

novelty_conclusion.parameterized_one_toggle_family: fully proved for the explicitly stated model, subject to independent peer review
novelty_conclusion.broad_deficient_edge_must_be_inserted_le: disproved; an alternate unused edge can repair P2 when the parameter gap permits it
novelty_conclusion.restricted_single_toggle_impossibility: fully proved under beta_minus=beta-1, degree-zero/private-endpoint, and one-toggle assumptions
novelty_conclusion.overall_claim: No publication-level novelty claim is supported. The defensible contribution is a corrected, clearly delimited mathematical diagnosis of why the tested one-toggle variant cannot maintain P1/P2 on a parameterized family. Close this direction as an independently verified educational/engineering result.
